metadata.description: AGGRESSIVE snap-pitch forward dash. Phases (durations s): snap-forward 0.15 (pitch rate +5.24 rad/s), dash 0.6 (thrust 11.78 N @ +45° pitch), snap-back 0.15, hover 0.6. Total 1.50 s, 150 actions. The 'trajectory' field is a kinematic intent assuming PERFECT rate tracking — the real sim will deviate from it due to PID transients. This file is for visualization (bright |ω| stripes + tilted body-z arrows), not strict validation. If you want to validate, loosen the tolerances substantially.
